checks.name: example: General Session opens with 5 presets, 3 destinations, 2 AUX outputs
save / load: the show is identical after a save and a reload
undo / redo: a layer change undoes and redoes
Simple: one preset tile per preset and layer chips on the canvas
Simple: Add Preset adds one, Delete removes it
Simple: copy a preset and paste it onto another
Simple: Add Destination opens its window, adds the destination, and it can be removed
Simple: Duplicate destination carries the clip settings (fit, In / Out, speed, level, look) and is one undo step
Simple: Add AUX adds an output that is on in every preset, Remove takes it away
Simple: an AUX can be switched off for one preset only
Simple: the layer panel lists Position, Size, Opacity, Mask, Border, Shadow, Effects
Simple: the layer panel title reads in full and no caption in the panel is cut off
Simple: typing a Width in the layer panel resizes the layer and the height follows the lock
Simple: a masked layer can sit past the edge by the masked amount, and a Size edit leaves its position alone
Simple: Delete and Backspace never remove a selected destination, a selected layer still goes and comes back with one undo
Simple: a click on a destination that is half out of view does not move the canvas, and click then double-click opens Destination Properties
Simple: a click outside closes the Destination, Layer and AUX panels (another destination, the same destination, the toolbar), a click inside keeps them open
new layer: starts as a centred PIP at half the destination (plain = half by half, a locked picture keeps its shape), also in a slot a removed layer left behind
mask: each side goes to 99 %, opposite sides never pass 99 % together (typed and pasted), one undo per edit, and the Look Book prints it
Simple: an Area of Interest can be switched on and off for a destination
Simple: an active Area of Interest has an Off button on the destination, and Off is one undo step
Simple: Destination Properties Apply is one undo step, Undo brings back size, position and rotation together and nothing older
Simple: Destination Properties copies and pastes Size, Position and Rotation between destinations and presets, resets them, shows the aspect ratio
Simple: the EDID note is kept per destination per preset, survives save and load, follows a destination copy and goes with a deleted destination
Advanced: opens on a preset with the sources rail and the properties panel
Advanced: both side panels collapse to a strip and come back

Advanced: a 4:3 picture dropped on a locked layer reshapes the window to 4:3
Advanced: a media layer adds Filters, Color and Source crop sections
Advanced: Filters offers B&W, Negative and Sepia
Advanced: Width and Scale are one window (Width 960 gives Height 720 and Scale 120%)
Advanced: unlocking the aspect switches the layer to Stretch, locking again snaps it back

Advanced: dragging a corner of a locked layer keeps its shape and the panel follows
Advanced: a clip dropped on the BG selects the BG and lists it like a layer

exports: a clip BG is written as a layer with its details

Advanced: a Display button sits left of Zoom, shows the format note first, and Cancel opens nothing

Advanced: closes cleanly
